locator: §5.2, 'Realists on the other hand think that our thought and talk is explained by these entities or properties.'
interpretation: The realist side of Dreier's order-of-explanation criterion. Read as realism's answer to Q-MORAL-GROUNDING: moral properties and truths explain moral thought and talk. The Catholic grounding answer (goodness is actuality, evil privation; CatholicGrounding, #160) is a realist answer of this order. Attribution reading on a secondary witness: the claim records the position the entry reports, not a thesis of the entry's author. No primary text is pinnable (in copyright, no immutable open text).
